lines.text: Many learners say: Turn light at the corner.
Better: Turn right at the corner.
The word right has an r sound.
Right! Turn right at the corner.

data.why: The word right has an r sound.

native.hook: right と light、聞き分けられる？
native.tip: right は r、light は l の音。書くときも r と l を間違えないで。
native.caption: “Turn light at the corner.”と言っていませんか？😅 日本語には r と l の区別がないので、綴りも混ざりがちです。“Turn right at the corner.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“right”。“Turn right at the corner.” を声に出して言ってみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Right has an r. Light has an l. They are different words.
en.caption: Do you say this? “Turn light at the corner.” 😅 Japanese does not separate r and l, so the spelling gets mixed. The natural way is “Turn right at the corner.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
